**Changelog for story-short-write v1.1.31**

- Updated agent bundle version check from 35 to 36, and adjusted related version handling instructions.
- Removed references/hooks-paragraph.md, references/output-contract.md, references/short-prose-quality.md, references/writing-workflow.md, and skill-card.md.
- Fine-tuned must-read file loading sequence and clarifications in the writing pipeline, including more granular distinctions for required parameters in Phase 3 (字数目标 now relies on 设定.md and platform defaults).
- Clarified author memory handover (now references for rewrite/de-slip only carry prose_style).
- Adjusted documentation on workflow, submission-craft.md usage, and file requirements for progression, removing requirements to acknowledge which references have been read.
- Updated process notes and technical remarks wording for fallback, agent, and spawn situations.

**Changelog (story-short-write 1.1.29)**

- Major structure update and refinement of writing stage rules and file handling, clarifying file-based handover between phases.
- Updated and streamlined SKILL.md for clarity; modified, removed and added multiple reference files to improve modularity.
- Introduced new references (e.g., `deslop-gates.md`, `story-logic.md`) and removed outdated or redundant ones.
- Improved memory management and agent spawn logic; agents_version bumped to 35.
- Polished process descriptions to reduce repetition and enhance phase-locked required readings.
- Enhanced “style resolution” and “author memory” flows for better reuse of author preferences.

story-short-write 1.1.22

- 优化 author_memory_commit.py，调整作者记忆复用逻辑，确保输出的 lines 字段仅作自然倾向，不逐条命中或影响连贯性，未完全装下时交稿时原文提示作者
- references/author-memory-maintenance.md 文档内容更新，完善作者习惯和记忆复用相关说明
- references/author-memory.md 精简和修订，反映脚本调用与数据流最新细节
- SKILL.md 执行规则「复用作者习惯」部分文本修订，细化 author_memory_commit.py 查询和调用规约
- 移除 skill-card.md，文档结构更简洁
- 其他细节调整，提升执行一致性
